changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Crear productos' AS name, 'product.create' AS code, 'INVENTORY' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver productos', 'product.read', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar productos', 'product.update', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar productos', 'product.delete', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear categorias de producto', 'productCategory.create', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver categorias de producto', 'productCategory.read', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar categorias de producto', 'productCategory.update', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar categorias de producto', 'productCategory.delete', 'INVENTORY'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear servicios', 'service.create', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver servicios', 'service.read', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar servicios', 'service.update', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar servicios', 'service.delete', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear categorias de servicio', 'serviceCategory.create', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver categorias de servicio', 'serviceCategory.read', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar categorias de servicio', 'serviceCategory.update', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar categorias de servicio', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'SERVICES'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear promociones', 'promotion.create', 'PROMOTIONS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver promociones', 'promotion.read', 'PROMOTIONS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar promociones', 'promotion.update', 'PROMOTIONS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar promociones', 'promotion.delete', 'PROMOTIONS'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear impuestos', 'tax.create', 'TAXES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver impuestos', 'tax.read', 'TAXES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar impuestos', 'tax.update', 'TAXES' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar impuestos', 'tax.delete', 'TAXES' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'product.create', 'product.read', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.read', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.read', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.read', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.read', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.read', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ( 'product.create', 'product.read', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.read', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.read', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.read', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.read', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.read', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'product.create', 'product.read', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.read', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.read', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.read', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.read', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.read', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, bp.sub_module_id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.sub_module_id = ce.sub_module_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = bp.sub_module_id AND sm.code IN ('INVENTORY', 'SERVICES', 'PROMOTIONS', 'TAXES') WHERE ce.access_level IN ('FULL', 'READ_ONLY') AND bp.code IN ('product.read', 'productCategory.read', 'service.read', 'serviceCategory.read', 'promotion.read', 'tax.read') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, bp.sub_module_id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.sub_module_id = ce.sub_module_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = bp.sub_module_id AND sm.code IN ('INVENTORY', 'SERVICES', 'PROMOTIONS', 'TAXES') WHERE ce.access_level = 'FULL' AND bp.code IN ('product.create', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('product.create', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ( 'product.create', 'product.read', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.read', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.read', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.read', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.read', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.read', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code IN ( 'product.create', 'product.read', 'product.update', 'product.delete', 'productCategory.create', 'productCategory.read', 'productCategory.update', 'productCategory.delete', 'service.create', 'service.read', 'service.update', 'service.delete', 'serviceCategory.create', 'serviceCategory.read', 'serviceCategory.update', 'serviceCategory.delete', 'promotion.create', 'promotion.read', 'promotion.update', 'promotion.delete', 'tax.create', 'tax.read', 'tax.update', 'tax.delete'));
